rv.q: She makes an already striking play about the push and pull between cultural tradition and independence all the more compelling.
For a first-time playwright, The Hungry Ghost is a confident and wonderfully original piece of writing, and one that leaves its audience hungry for whatever Yew serves up next.
It's enjoyable and worth seeing – expect to laugh a lot – but it isn't flawless.
The Ghost's departure from Girl leaves a sense of a story well rounded and well told, though a little more time with the Ghost's life before she became a ghost might have been even more satisfying.
